grammar.summary: 本课学习 must 表推测与 appear 的系动词用法。

points.title: must be 表推测
points.explanation: 依据外表的肯定推测：She must be at least forty.（她肯定至少40岁）；否定推测 can't be。

examples.en: She must be at least thirty-five years old.

points.title: appear/seem 系动词
points.explanation: appear = 似乎：She often appears as a young girl. appear 后接形容词或 as 短语，语义同 seem。

examples.en: In spite of this, she often appears on the stage.
examples.cn: 尽管如此，她仍经常登台演出。

exercises.q: I can't boot my computer now. Something ___ （一定出了毛病) with its operation system.
